title: Libri, conto economico e flussi di cassa
intro: Review posted activity and period balances: general ledger detail, trial balance, and balance sheet.

sections.title: General ledger
steps: Filter by account and date range to inspect posted lines.
Use this view to drill into journal activity for an account.
sections.caption: General ledger tab.

sections.title: Trial balance
sections.intro: Trial balance lists debit and credit totals by account for a period.
steps: Choose the period or as-of date your venue uses.
Confirm debits equal credits before relying on statements.
sections.caption: Trial balance tab.

sections.title: Balance sheet
steps: Review assets, liabilities, and equity for the selected date.
Other statement tabs (Profit & loss, Cash flow) follow the same pattern.
sections.caption: Balance sheet tab.

sections.title: Profitti e perdite
sections.intro: Conto economico del periodo: ricavi, costo venduto e spese.
sections.caption: Scheda profitti e perdite.

sections.title: Flusso di cassa
sections.intro: Riassume movimenti operativi, investimenti e finanziamento.
steps: Apri Flusso di cassa in Conti.
Rivedi saldo iniziale, variazione e finale.
Usa con P&L per cassa vs. competenza.
sections.caption: Scheda flusso di cassa.
